tools.name: shared_service_equipment
tools.notes: Current running catalog includes Slack, GitHub, Gemini lifecycle, GrokBot lifecycle, and commons_team_workhandoff; service custody stays in the existing host stores.

tools.name: commons_team_workhandoff
tools.notes: Available through the same dynamic capability manifest to every peer. Uploads the exact patch file, shares it in the verified internal BountyHub thread, and reads back file bytes/message text/sender/provider footer before reporting delivery. Its durable journal stores hashes and provider receipts, not patch bytes.

tools.name: slack_read_file
tools.notes: Fetches the shared patch by file ID through the existing encrypted Slack credential; no new peer grant or holder session.

tools.name: slack_post_external_demo_message
tools.notes: Public demo copy only, to michael-external-demo (C0C7S2D5QRE); no channel, sender or icon override. sender must be the installed bot B0BTD42EMFY; DELIVERED only after provider readback. Reuse operation_id; accepted or uncertain sends are never repeated. The generic slack_post_message stays internal-workspace only. Docs: integrations/shared_equipment/EXTERNAL_DEMO.md.

tools.name: slack_external_demo_message_status
tools.notes: Reads back an existing external demo operation without sending; optional message_ts reconciles a provider handle recovered after an interrupted send. Use the original operation_id with a new call_id. sender must be the installed bot B0BTD42EMFY; DELIVERED only after provider readback.

tools.name: equipment_capability_manifest
tools.entry: CLI: python -m integrations.shared_equipment.services manifest; Slack envelope name equipment_capability_manifest
tools.notes: Dynamic non-secret capability inventory. Same operations for every peer. Peer labels never gate discovery. No credential bytes.

access_routes.name: owner_pc_shared_equipment
access_routes.note: Equipment envelopes use stable request_id and call_id. A Gemini tool result contains the separate model request_id.

access_routes.name: owner_pc_grokbot_control
access_routes.note: GrokBot pools only. Occupant field is optional metadata on the pool run, not role_id. Do not relaunch on owner PC until RAM incident cleared. TENON/HINGE/WEDGE equipment cards include diagnostic loaders, open-obligations, advance, equip/release/transfer/bind/unbind/export/import/inspect, normalize, prove-handoff — import-only wraps of transferable_roles.

access_routes.name: workspace_shared_equipment
access_routes.submit: Post envelope to channel C0BU51F1PL3 thread 1788567066.179399
access_routes.status: Read commons_equipment_result replies with matching request_id and call_id
access_routes.note: Use the same operation schemas over the existing workspace connector. No secret material belongs in the envelope. Discover via equipment_capability_manifest.
